subject: Grate Guy's Casino
text: ShadowVictor75 says you first need the Bright Card from the Knife Guy in Booster's Tower, guessing which hand holds the yellow ball until you win it.

evidence.quote: Primeiro tu precisa da Bright Card,que vc consegue do Knife Guy na torre do Booster
evidence.translation: First you need the Bright Card, which you get from the Knife Guy in Booster's Tower

subject: Knife Guy
text: ShadowVictor75 says to get the Bright Card you must guess which of the Knife Guy's hands holds the yellow ball, repeating until you win the card.

evidence.quote: vc tem que adivinhar em qual das maos ele tem a bola amarela,faz isso ate ganhar a Bright Card
evidence.translation: you have to guess which hand he has the yellow ball in, do this until you win the Bright Card

subject: Grate Guy's Casino
text: ShadowVictor75 says that at the end of Bean Valley you take the top pipe next to the yellow Chomp and jump so a secret block appears that leads to the Casino.

evidence.quote: Vai no cano de cima,bem ao lado do Chomp amarelo,da um pulo que ira aparecer um bloco secreto que vai te levar ao Casino
evidence.translation: Go to the top pipe, right next to the yellow Chomp, jump and a secret block will appear that takes you to the Casino

subject: Bright Card
text: wedgordo says the Knife Guy's yellow-ball challenge requires 10 correct guesses.

evidence.quote: O número de acertos são 10.

subject: Chomp Chomp
text: wedgordo says that in the Bean Valley spot with 5 pipes you enter the north pipe and beat the Golden Jaw Chomp Chomp inside.

evidence.quote: quando encontrar o local com 5 canos, entre no cano ao norte. Dentro, vença o Mandíbula Dourada "Chomp Chomp".
evidence.translation: when you find the place with 5 pipes, enter the pipe to the north. Inside, beat the Golden Jaw "Chomp Chomp".

subject: Grate Guy's Casino
object: jump 3 times at far left corner
text: wedgordo says that after the Chomp Chomp fight you go to the far left corner and jump 3 times, then jump onto the platform and exit.

evidence.quote: vá para o canto (extrema esquerda) e pula 3 vezes. Pule na plataforma e saia.
evidence.translation: go to the corner (far left) and jump 3 times. Jump onto the platform and exit.

subject: Grate Guy's Casino
text: wedgordo says that to enter the casino you show the Bright Card to the guards.

evidence.quote: mostre o dedo e o Bright Card pros seguranças e já era.
evidence.translation: show the finger and the Bright Card to the guards and that's it.

evidence.quote: Não precisa ser consecutivos.
evidence.translation: They do not need to be consecutive.
